On pi-durable hosts, workspace.viewImage reads the file within Pi's limits,
recognizes it by its magic bytes, and attaches it to the result the model
receives. A new `images` option takes pi-durable's ImageProcessor to fit
images to the model; without one, inline formats within the byte limit pass
through as they are.

Images that tools.* calls return now attach too, including from tools with
an output schema, whose images were dropped without notice.

The per-invocation slot logic and bounded file read move to
src/workspace/image-attachments.ts, shared by the Pi and durable
